articles.title: US and Russia Reach Accord to Send Russian Diesel to Global Markets
articles.summary: President Donald Trump announced an agreement for Russia to provide diesel to international markets to reduce costs. This agreement shifts the previous years of economic pressure applied to Russia following its Ukraine invasion.
articles.origTitle: Trump, Putin agree on deal to release Russian diesel to US, world markets
articles.origSummary: Russia will supply diesel to global markets in a bid to lower prices, US President Donald Trump has said. The move reverses years of pressure on the Russian economy following the invasion of Ukraine.
